verdict.rationale: Penpot explicitly states 'Keep your data private. Penpot will never make business out of your data. Choose where and how to host it, and decide who has access to it,' and supports full self-hosting/on-prem/private-cloud deployment giving users complete control over their data and any AI/MCP integrations. This directly addresses preventing data use for AI training, reinforced by self-hosted MCP deployment options avoiding third-party clouds. Missing for 10: independent/third-party verification of the no-training claim, and no explicit documented AI-training opt-out policy or data-processing agreement beyond the marketing statement.
